0.content: Over a decade before the Traveler's arrival, fetor leaked from the border and gathered at Wuwang Hill. Old Hu and his son went there to burn it away with the Art of Homa. The son, held back by attachments, faltered and was killed at once. Old Hu managed the fallout, but a nearby village was lost and the hill is still shrouded in fog and blue ghost lights. Details come from the 5.3 Springtime Charms quest, a limited-time event.
